title: Rob D NDE 3216
content: I had massive heart attack on the side of highway. The nurse stopped after five minutes, did CPR until ambulance arrived fifteen to twenty minutes after the event. I was shocked seven or eight times all told roadside, ambulance, Emergency Room, operating room before I stabilized. I have been told that survival under these conditions is impossible. I have had short term memory problems and problems focusing but brain has been re-circuiting itself, much improved. I have no memory from the time I opened the door on my truck until six days later, but remember being on the other side clearly. This experience is described below.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) . No heartbeat or pulse for twenty minutes, trauma to head from fall onto interstate highway.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Special Knowledge | Life review | Boundary
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Total absence of time.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: All hearing during conversations was telepathic, as was conversation.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Hard to describe; no tunnel, like a whoosh, then into an area. Not a room but had the feeling of boundaries. An area.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Dead friends told me what had happened. All communication was telepathic. I asked where my dead stepson was. I was told he had gone back. I asked why they had not? I was told that time and space do not exist here. One second, one year, one thousand years, all the same. I was told we all go back many times, until we have learned what is needed to ascend to a higher state of being. We are all a part of a greater being, he experiences what we experience. All things, the grass, air, trees, everything has a living force and is of as much importance to the creator as are we. The planet we live on is alive, and should be as revered as human life. They told me they were unsure if my body could be revived. If it was, I should be willing to speak with those who would listen about what I had been told. I was told that I would experience things that would give me an opportunity to review how I had lived. I was told that all is forgiven, all spirit is eternal, and all can be redeemed.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Tolerance of those with different views.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Have had feelings of need to go or do things out of my usual routine, has proved to be of benefit to me or others.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: All had great meaning. I know, not believe, but know, that what was revealed to me was the truth.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes Reading about it. Don't believe it affected experience.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. The knowing is the marvelous part. The awareness that we are all connected, all the same, all equal.
